logo_override.validation_detail: Official UMN Twin Cities lockup wordmark (block M + 'UNIVERSITY OF MINNESOTA / TWIN CITIES' text) from the site's own Folwell theme. Probed: HTTP 200, content-type image/svg+xml, 21859 bytes. SVG <style> defines only two fills: .fill-block-m #6d001f (UMN maroon block M) and .fill-text #000 (black text) - no white and no white-on-transparent, so it is safe on a white background. Discovered from the site's own stylesheet (themes/custom/folwell/css/folwell.css) which lists branding/wordmarks/umnhf-campus-tc-no-dtd-gold.svg and the matching -maroon.svg; same branding set loads on the shard's record page (h1 'Global Excellence Scholarships').
logo_override._award: Global Excellence Scholarship (University of Minnesota Twin Cities)

notes: admissions.tc.umn.edu sits behind a WAF that returns an HTML 403 block page to non-browser clients: webfetch of the HTML pages, curl, and HEAD requests all 403, so HTML pages had to be read via Playwright. Asset GETs via webfetch and same-origin browser fetch both returned 200 with correct image content types, and the 403 HTML body was verified to be a block page rather than the asset. Chose the full-colour wordmark lockup SVG over alternatives per the prefer-full-wordmark rule. Rejected/secondary: themes/custom/folwell/images/branding/wordmarks/M-wordmark.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 1608 bytes, alt 'UMN block M wordmark') is the maroon block M only - a valid official mark but a bare mark with no wordmark and very small; kept as fallback. Rejected: sites/admissions.tc.umn.edu/files/favicon_192x192.png (declared as link rel=icon but 403 to every probe) and the campus-wide 'umnhf-campus-d/m/c/r/e/sc-*' wordmarks, which belong to the UMN Duluth/Morris/Crookston/Rochester/Extension and St. Cloud campuses rather than Twin Cities. The '-gold' filename is a Folwell theme variant label; the served bytes are the maroon-M/black-text light-background variant, confirmed by reading the actual fill values.
